mapper.insert: insert into SIMULATION(USER_ID, SNAPSHOT_ID, START_DATE, END_DATE, ENDING_BALANCE, TARGET_RATE, PREP_MONTHS) values(#{userId}, #{snapshotId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{endingBalance}, #{targetRate}, #{prepMonths})
mapper.select: select * from SIMULATION where USER_ID = #{userId} and CONFIRMED_AT is null and IS_DELETED = false order by CREATED_AT desc limit 1
select * from SIMULATION where USER_ID = #{userId} and CONFIRMED_AT is not null and IS_DELETED = false order by CONFIRMED_AT desc limit 1
